title: GOOD COCK BAD COCK
description:
WARNING: EXPLICIT CONTENT (explicit in its meaning)
This film reenacts an encounter with U.S. border control, where deportation followed suspicions about artistic identity and sex work. The question “Are you a whore?” got asked after 2 border officers saw snippets of Head Over Heels. Despite its title and overall aesthetic suggesting otherwise, the action lies within the dialogue to show how language and misrecognition police hyper-femininity.

title: HEAD OVER HEELS
description: After a Bimbo-Gang™ squatted the Playboy Mansion (staged), they craved a latte. Sending NELLY out to get them, a whole chain of unexpected (real) events followed. The 'film'(?) mixes documentary footage, GTA & 3D art to capture the 21st Century Queer Bimbo Zeitgeist.

title: LOCKED IN & TAPPED OUT
description:
LOCKED IN & TAPPED OUT came about after working as an escape-room game master and participating in the Dutch pilot of the reality competition The Genius. Mixing live action and 3D animation, the work takes the form of a fictional escape-room game show set inside a 3D model of NELLY DANSEN. The project explores Bimbofatigue™: the moment a persona becomes a character you can no longer log out of. Can you escape a version of yourself that you performed into existence?

CAN YOU?
WILL YOU?
DO YOU EVEN WANT TO?
